One thing is for certain: the abundant wildlife and incredible landscapes - from tumbling glaciers and lush forests to towering walls of rock - you’ll see on our wildlife and glacier cruises in Kenai Fjords National Park will create memories to last a lifetime. This exclusive Thursday partner cruise with Alaska SeaLife Center features expert insights into animals of Resurrection Bay. blurb: Guests cruise up the coast from Seward on narrated ocean cruises to see abundant wildlife and incredible landscapes including glaciers, forests, and rock walls. Tours explore Kenai Fjords National Park with opportunities to see whales, sea otters, sea lions, puffins, and more. Some tours include multi-course dinners glacier-side or special editions with the Alaska SeaLife Center.
